title: Hummus à la Noah
subtitle: silky tahini hummus
menu_blurb: A very smooth, creamy hummus blended with tahini, lemon and garlic, finished with za’atar and pine nuts. A crowd pleaser every time.
intro: A very smooth, creamy, flavorful dip, perfect for pita chips, crudités, and sandwiches. This recipe is a crowd pleaser! Fun fact: my niece Lara, a hummus lover, will only eat Noah’s hummus.
origin: Hummus comes from the Middle East, although which country can claim it is hotly debated. “Hummus” is the Arabic word for chickpea, and the dish’s full traditional name, hummus bi tahini, means “chickpeas with tahini.”

mise_en_place.label: Prepare
mise_en_place.task: Peel the garlic and squeeze 2 lemons

steps.title: Prepare
instructions: Drain the chickpeas, saving the liquid from the can. This is called aquafaba.

steps.title: Blend
instructions: Add the chickpeas, lemon juice, aquafaba, tahini, and salt, and blend until very smooth.

steps.title: Taste
instructions: Add more tahini, lemon, and salt as needed.

steps.title: Serve
instructions: Sprinkle with za’atar and pine nuts, and serve with pita chips and/or crudités.

tips.label: Flavor boost
tips.tip: Add cumin, pine nuts, and salt as needed.

tips.label: Meal prep hack
tips.tip: Keeps in the fridge for many days.

notebook.question: What is aquafaba, and is it good for you?
answer: Aquafaba is the thick, starchy liquid left over from canned chickpeas or other cooked legumes. Its mix of plant proteins and starches lets it whip, bind, and emulsify, which makes it a popular vegan substitute for egg whites and whole eggs.

It is safe and healthy as a plant-based egg and oil alternative, but it is very low in nutrients, with only trace amounts of protein and minerals, and it may cause gas or bloating for sensitive stomachs.

notebook.question: What is tahini, and is it good for you?
answer: Tahini is a smooth, creamy paste made from ground sesame seeds, a staple of Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cooking best known in hummus and baba ghanoush.
Yes, it is very healthy. It provides healthy unsaturated fats, plant protein, and minerals like copper and iron, plus sesame compounds that help lower inflammation.
